text:
sam: Proposal — create a provisional, timeboxed 'incident playback' log snapshot flow for urgent triage. idea: 72h snapshot TTL, signed manifest, KMS-wrapped export, and RBAC temporary leases. want feedback before i file a formal RFC.
leah: +1 to the idea. can you clarify what "provisional" means vs current ephemeral snapshots?
omar: curious about the 72h TTL. is that from creation or from access grant?
sam: provisional = short-lived export intended for incident response + tribunal evidence staging. creation timestamp -> TTL starts at creation. access grants are separate and short-lived (e.g., 4h leases tied to an audit ticket).
maya: sounds reasonable. two immediate concerns: 1) how do we ensure privacy-minimization (mask PII) for rapid triage, 2) KMS unwrap audit and who can request unwrap.
sam: good call. proposed controls: (1) default scrub pipeline for velocity snapshots (strip emails, ip5), (2) require JIT KMS unwrap via sec-bot requesting an HSM-wrapped key with approval chain, (3) all unwraps emit an immutable audit event with user, ticket ID and reason.
leah: can we make scrub levels selectable at request time? e.g. minimal scrub (for deep forensic) vs triage scrub?
sam: yes — two presets: triage (aggressive masking) and forensics (less masking, higher approvals + legal sign-off). include a flag in the request form.
omar: RBAC question: who gets the 4h lease by default? oncall? SRE leads? SOC analysts?
maya: my vote: default -> oncall (sre-oncall & soc) + requestor; expanded -> requires manager + sec-approved justification. everything logged.
sam: agreed. also propose an automatic rollback: if any expanded access is granted we also spawn a cleanup job to scrub derived datasets after TTL.
sec-bot: SECURITY BOT: New snapshot request template created at https://internal.redwood/snapshots/template. Checklist enforced on submit: ticket id, scrub preset, TTL, approvers.
leah: can we add a short request template snippet here for the playbook? i can wire it into the runbook.
sam: sure. use this minimal template for JIT requests:
```
requester: @alice
ticket: RDW-1234
scope: service-a logs 2026-03-20T08:00..2026-03-20T10:00
scrub_preset: triage
TTL_hours: 72
approvers: oncall, sec-lead
justification: "incident playback for root cause triage"
```
maya: and add required artifacts for forensics preset: legal sign-off field + retention override reason.
legal: quick note from Legal: for any instance where snapshot is retained >30 days or exported off-platform we need documented justification and legal approval. keep the default short.
omar: KMS unwrap flow - technical ask: can we require envelope keys that are HSM-backed and limit unwraps to the KMS proxy service? that would prevent wide key material exposure.
sam: yes. plan: snapshot encrypted with per-snapshot data key (DEK), DEK wrapped by customer CMK or platform CMK depending on env, unwrap via KMS proxy with ephemeral session tokens and strict RBAC. all unwrap requests require ticket id.
leah: can we add a signed manifest artifact to every snapshot so downstream teams can verify integrity? e.g., manifest.json + sha256 + signer = sec-bot.
sam: yes — manifest will include scope, hashes, scrub_preset, created_by, ticket, TTL, and signature. example manifest generation will be part of the pipeline.
maya: operational question: how do we prevent accidental retention after a legal hold? need a manual override and a separate retention workflow.
legal: legal hold requests should create a new ticket flagged HOOKED-HOLD; snapshot TTL must be paused and retention extension recorded with approver chain. only legal+sec can remove HOOKED-HOLD.
sec-bot: SECURITY BOT: Checklist proposal (to be auto-validated at submit): 1) ticket id present 2) scrub preset chosen 3) TTL <= 168h unless legal hold 4) approvers list not empty 5) manifest signature generated 6) kms-wrap confirmed
omar: small nit: TTL <=168h default guard rails, but allow 72h recommended.
sam: next steps: i'll open RFC with flow diagrams, kube job pseudo-config, and sample request API. if no blockers, i'll implement the template and add runbook entries.
leah: 👍 ping me when RFC is up. i'll add runbook steps and the quick CLI helper for oncall.
maya: also add an alert if >3 expansions of access were requested for same snapshot (suspicious).
sam: noted. thanks all. filing RFC now. :rocket:
